    - After the helper completes, locate role='article' children under role='main'. Guard
      any .nth() indexing with an await .count() call to avoid indexing errors.
    - Use the full chained accessibility-role path from main -> article -> heading(level=2) -> link
      to unambiguously target the article title link, then click it as the final action.

    # Utility of KB functions considered:

    # Ensure results region is present (helper typically waits for this, but be robust).

        await page.get_by_role("main").wait_for(timeout=5000)

    # Locate articles inside the main region.
    main = page.get_by_role("main")
    articles = main.get_by_role("article")

    # Guard .nth() with a count() call to avoid indexing errors.

    title_link = third_article.get_by_role("heading", level=2).get_by_role("link")

    # Click the title link. This may navigate away, so perform it as the final action.
    await title_link.click()
